source: maintainer independent review of exec/d1-behavioural-readiness@7dd31165 (Post-D2-v3-Search Independent Review, section 3)
scope: DERIVED evidence only. The search's raw records (states.jsonl, telemetry, d2_search.json, stage1_selection.json, manifest), its ranking, its Top-4 and every digest are unchanged; no selection, rule or number the search produced moves.

superseded_by.derivation: scripts/stages/stage-1/phase_d2/analyze_d2_search.py (ANALYSIS_VERSION 2), same inputs: the archived states.jsonl/telemetry.jsonl, stage1_selection.json and D1's search journal

corrections.was: two shared states / 'reproduces D1's state.teacher_kl on the two states the searches share by artifact digest'
corrections.is: 2 D2 state records and 2 D1 state records of ONE artifact (e63a36e4e03b, the root DEPTH expansion under each profile produced identical bytes in both searches): 1 independent comparison, not two. On it D2's root teacher-top-k KL 0.511197 vs D1's historical teacher-top-k KL 0.511240: |difference| 4.29e-05 (8.38e-05 relative). That is agreement on one artifact under DIFFERENT teacher-logit numerical protocols, not a reproduction of D1's metric and not a validation of either evaluator in general.

corrections.was: 'd1_metric_teacher_kl_equal_domain_mean', read from the D2 state's state.teacher_kl.equal_domain_mean
corrections.is: under D2 v3 a D2 state's state.teacher_kl.* is the UNWEIGHTED UNION-support KL (equal to state.objective.raw_kl.*), NOT D1's historical teacher Top-K + tail KL. Version 2 names it d2_state_teacher_kl_equal_domain_mean_is_union_kl and asserts the equality per leaf.

corrections.was: 'On that metric D2's best leaf is 7.2009 ... D1's best leaf was 7.4341'
corrections.is: D2's best leaf on ITS root teacher-top-k KL is 7.2009; D1's best leaf on ITS historical teacher-top-k KL is 7.4341. Same support family, different teacher-logit protocol, tie-break and prediction rows: an approximately comparable step-0 proxy, never a behavioural or D1-vs-D2 verdict. D2's unweighted union KL (7.2054) and objective are on a different support and must not be set against D1's number.

d2_objective.support: reference_student_union_topk_tail_v1: teacher Top-200 UNION candidate Top-200, + one tail; deterministic tie-break (value desc, index asc)
d2_objective.weighting: c_T(t) = 1 - H^{K+1}_T(t)/log(K+1), the frozen teacher's Top-K + tail confidence; denominator 1/T_x
d2_objective.teacher_logits: root reference store: float32 product of the model-dtype final hidden state and the output head, accumulated in float32 (never rounded to bf16); candidate-only entries retrieved from the stored hidden state and log-normalizer

d2_unweighted_union_kl.same_as: state.teacher_kl.equal_domain_mean OF A D2 STATE (under v3 the evaluator's KL is the union-support KL, so the two fields are equal)

d2_root_teacher_topk_kl.what: teacher Top-K + tail KL of the same pair (D2's built-in KL-only control on D1's support family)
d2_root_teacher_topk_kl.support: reference_topk_tail_v1 shape: teacher Top-200 + one tail, with D2's deterministic tie-break
d2_root_teacher_topk_kl.teacher_logits: as d2_objective (float32 head product from the root store)

d1_historical_teacher_topk_kl.field: state.teacher_kl.equal_domain_mean OF A D1 STATE (D1's journal)
d1_historical_teacher_topk_kl.support: reference_topk_tail_v1: teacher Top-200 + one tail, torch.topk (no deterministic tie-break)
d1_historical_teacher_topk_kl.reference: the root teacher at state evaluation
d1_historical_teacher_topk_kl.teacher_logits: the teacher's own forward: bf16 logits from the model, upcast to float32 (teacher(ids).logits.float())

unchanged: the ranking and the committed Top-4
every artifact, weights and checkpoint digest
the closeout's completion, money and teardown records
